status_reason: survived source falsification with a concrete attacker path; local PoC/fork proof required before human promotion (POC_REQUIRED = local PoC-task permission only)

share_lock_period.evidence: sell requires now>lastTradeTimestamp[credId][curator]+SHARE_LOCK_PERIOD (Cred.sol L625), but ANY buyer-for resets lastTradeTimestamp[credId][curator]=now on buy (L644 single, L759 batch)

invariant_analysis.broken_invariant: a curator's ability to sell their own shares must not be controllable by a third party; buying FOR an address must not extend that address's sell-lock
invariant_analysis.why_defenses_do_not_block: the lock itself is the griefing vector; no check that the lock-setter is the share owner

exploit_path.attacker_profile: any EOA (permissionless); harms a third-party victim
exploit_path.preconditions: victim holds shares of credId they wish to sell
exploit_path.transaction_sequence: attacker calls buyShareCredFor(credId,1,victim,maxPrice) (or batchBuyShareCred curator_=victim); each buy sets lastTradeTimestamp[credId][victim]=block.timestamp (L644/L759). The sell path (_handleTrade L625) requires block.timestamp>lastTradeTimestamp+SHARE_LOCK_PERIOD, so by periodically buying 1 share FOR the victim the attacker keeps the victim's lock from ever elapsing -> victim cannot sell.
exploit_path.state_after: victim's lastTradeTimestamp perpetually reset -> sell blocked
exploit_path.rejection_case: Maybe lastTradeTimestamp is per-(curator==msg.sender). It is NOT: it is keyed [credId][curator_] where curator_ is an arbitrary buy-for target (buyShareCredFor L186-188, batch curator_ param). So a third party controls the victim's lock. Not falsified.
exploit_path.source_evidence: buyShareCredFor L186-188; _handleTrade L644 (set) + L625 (sell check); _executeBatchTrade L759

impact_analysis.impact_category: denial of asset movement (victim's shares locked from selling by a third party)
impact_analysis.minimum_profit_or_damage_condition: attacker pays the buy price per grief tx; victim's shares are denied sale while griefed (involuntary)
